$comment: The `_SKILLS` keyword table lifted verbatim from apps/ai-service/app/profiling/signals.py.
ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING and must not be sorted: a generic term must never shadow a specific
one. `tool offset` precedes `offset` so that 'tool offset setting' keys the specific skill,
and both map to the same taxonomy id on purpose.
Consumed twice. Directly, as the keyword table. Indirectly, via the {SKILL_KEYWORDS} macro
in negation.json's `skills` topic cue — which is why this table lives in its own file rather
than inline there. Before the extraction those two were the same Python list; keeping one
file is what stops them becoming two lists that drift.
